_schema.note: Grandfathered groups of identically-shaped function bodies — check 13 of scripts/validate_architecture.py.
_schema.rule: SHRINK-ONLY. A NEW cross-module body duplicate fails the gate. Do not add rows to normalise new copy-paste; promote the helper into a shared module and add a SHARED_HELPERS row instead.
_schema.baseline: 2026-08-26. Check 11 matches a promoted helper by NAME, so a copy that was merely renamed escaped it (register item 47). This check matches on body SHAPE — identifiers and literals erased, structure and attribute names kept — so a rename cannot hide a copy.
_schema.reading_a_row: Each group lists <module>::<function>. Several are genuine convergence targets; a few are legitimately parallel (the rpc/mixins _require_* service accessors) and are expected to stay.
